summary: Tile registry watches exclude read events in the Linux kernel; file gates ignore reads and unrelated ancestor activity while following target creation and replacement

replay.detail: No claims, projections or replay behavior changed.

compatibility.detail: Registry and file-gate formats are unchanged. Watches follow missing parent creation and atomic target replacement without waking on reads or sibling mutations. Backend rescan signals and mutations without paths invalidate every affected subscription so dropped event paths cannot leave observations stale.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous in-memory watcher behavior; no state migration is needed.
